_source.prompt: Square, 2048x2048. Orthographic view looking straight down on a single cut-out object centred in the frame, on a solid flat bright magenta (#ff00ff) background that fills everything outside the object, with no shadow cast on the background. Flat, even, shadowless lighting: no highlights, no vignette. No perspective, no text, no border, no watermark. Object: the flat-topped crown layer of an umbrella thorn tree (Vachellia tortilis) seen from directly above, one roughly circular, slightly lobed plate filling about 90% of the frame: a dense, flat mat of tiny bipinnate leaflets on fine interlaced twigs, thick and even in the middle, breaking up toward the rim into separate sprays with magenta showing between them, a few small gaps inside, no trunk or branches showing. Keep colours natural but slightly muted and even, so the texture can be tinted to different palettes without looking stained.
